name: secondhand-mcp

tools.name: search_marketplace
tools.description: Search for items on secondary marketplaces. Supports: facebook. Returns listing ID, title, price, location, and photo count. Facebook: location-based search, no auth. eBay: keyword search with condition filter, requires API keys. Use get_listing_details with a listing ID for full description, all photos, seller info, and shipping options.

marketplace.description: Marketplace to search. Options: facebook, or "all" to search all marketplaces

location.description: City or area to search (e.g., "san francisco", "nyc", "los angeles")

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20)

showSold.description: Include sold/unavailable items in results (default: false)

includeImages.description: Include full image URLs in results (default: false). Use get_listing_details for full photos.

tools.name: get_listing_details
tools.description: Get full details for a specific listing using an ID from search results. Facebook returns: description, all photos, location, seller name, delivery types, shipping availability. eBay returns: description, all photos, location (city/state/country), seller username, shipping service options.

listingId.description: The listing ID (from search results or a marketplace URL)

marketplace.description: Which marketplace the listing is from (default: facebook)

tools.name: list_marketplaces
tools.description: List all available marketplaces and their status
